strategy_question: After validating position 1, how should the SWA pipeline approach the remaining nine L03 OPI positions without propagating the first source package or inventing new language content?

routes.name: SOURCE_REVIEW_BEFORE_POSITION_2_ALLOCATION
routes.reason: Requires a fresh source/evidence review for the next unassigned structural position before any allocation or authoring, preserving separation between Language Core evidence and SWA curriculum assembly.

routes.name: REUSE_POSITION_1_PACKAGE_FOR_POSITION_2
routes.reason: No current evidence licenses propagation of VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE into another OPI slot.

routes.name: AUTHOR_ALL_REMAINING_POSITIONS_FROM_PATTERN_ANALOGY
routes.reason: Would fabricate curriculum and likely overgeneralize KE and L03 interrogative grammar.

constraints: Do not allocate position 2 in this strategy gate.
Do not reuse VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE outside position 1 without separate evidence and approval.
Do not invent new HNK forms, translations, subject/person, tense/aspect or copula semantics.
Do not create canonical OPI IDs or labels.
Do not unlock QA, STR003-STR005, other OPI or runtime.
